name: claudebeat
description: Plays a short 8-bit chiptune cue when Claude needs your attention. Eight NES/Game Boy voices to pick from.

defaultSound.title: Default sound
defaultSound.description: Default sound id to play for all events. Format: <pack>/<id> (e.g. chiptune/pixel, chiptune/ring). See sounds/index.json for available ids.

enableNotification.title: Enable Notification event sound
enableNotification.description: Play a sound on Notification events (Claude waiting for input). Enabled by default.

enablePermission.title: Enable PermissionRequest event sound
enablePermission.description: Play a sound on PermissionRequest events. Enabled by default.

enableStop.title: Enable Stop event sound
enableStop.description: Play a sound when Claude finishes responding (Stop event). Disabled by default — can be frequent.

notificationSound.title: Notification sound
notificationSound.description: Sound id or absolute .wav path for Notification events. Falls back to defaultSound if empty.

permissionSound.title: Permission request sound
permissionSound.description: Sound id or absolute .wav path for PermissionRequest events. Falls back to defaultSound if empty.

stopSound.title: Stop event sound
stopSound.description: Sound id or absolute .wav path for Stop events (requires enableStop: true). Falls back to defaultSound if empty.

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Playback volume (0.0 to 1.0). macOS only — ignored on Linux and Windows (afplay -v limitation). Use the OS mixer on other platforms.

cooldownSeconds.title: Cooldown (seconds)
cooldownSeconds.description: Minimum seconds between sounds. 0 = disabled. When > 0, the hook skips playback if another sound played within this window.

maxPerMinute.title: Max plays per minute
maxPerMinute.description: Maximum sounds per 60-second sliding window. 0 = disabled. When the limit is reached the hook skips playback.

recurringUntilInput.title: Recurring reminder until input
recurringUntilInput.description: Spawn a recurring child process that replays the notification sound every recurringIntervalSeconds until user input is detected. Note: the first sound plays ~60 s after Claude finishes (Claude Code idle_prompt delay). Disabled by default.

recurringIntervalSeconds.title: Recurring interval (seconds)
recurringIntervalSeconds.description: How often (in seconds) the recurring reminder plays after the first sound. Requires recurringUntilInput: true.

recurringMaxDurationSeconds.title: Recurring max duration (seconds)
recurringMaxDurationSeconds.description: Maximum total time (in seconds) the recurring loop runs before auto-stopping. Orphan safety valve. Requires recurringUntilInput: true.
